    return survivor + 1

{"code":"def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    M = inputs.get('M', inputs.get('matrix'))
    exponent = int(inputs.get('power', inputs.get('exponent', inputs.get('n'))))
    mod = int(inputs.get('mod', inputs.get('modulus', inputs.get('MOD'))))
    def mul(A, B):
        return [[(A[0][0]*B[0][0] + A[0][1]*B[1][0]) % mod,
                 (A[0][0]*B[0][1] + A[0][1]*B[1][1]) % mod],
                [(A[1][0]*B[0][0] + A[1][1]*B[1][0]) % mod,
                 (A[1][0]*B[0][1] + A[1][1]*B[1][1]) % mod]]
    result = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
    base = [[int(M[0][0]) % mod, int(M[0][1]) % mod],
            [int(M[1][0]) % mod, int(M[1][1]) % mod]]
    while exponent:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = mul(result, base)
        base = mul(base, base)
        exponent >>= 1
    return sum(map(sum, result))"}
